title: Mid-cycle plan changes and discount allocation in subscription billing
name: Subscription proration billing

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code rounds, splits and records monetary amounts? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A customer downgrades mid-period so that unused_credit is larger than new_charge. What does change_plan do?
choices: It raises ValueError because net is negative.
It posts a journal with a negative receivable amount (a credit to the customer) and an offsetting positive revenue amount, then returns the negative net.
It posts a zero-amount journal and drops the difference.
